script = '''
from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF
import os

# Read the actual DOCX file
doc = Document("./testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Create PDF
pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)
pdf.add_page()

for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if not text:
        pdf.ln(4)
        continue

    style_name = para.style.name.lower() if para.style else ""

    if "heading 1" in style_name or "title" in style_name:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 18)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 10, text)
        pdf.ln(4)
    elif "heading 2" in style_name:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 14)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, text)
        pdf.ln(3)
    elif "heading 3" in style_name:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 12)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, text)
        pdf.ln(2)
    else:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 11)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, text)
        pdf.ln(2)

# Handle tables
for table in doc.tables:
    pdf.ln(4)
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
    col_count = len(table.columns)
    col_width = (pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin) / col_count

    for i, row in enumerate(table.rows):
        if i == 0:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
        else:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
        for cell in row.cells:
            cell_text = cell.text.strip().replace("\\n", " ")
            pdf.cell(col_width, 7, cell_text, border=1)
        pdf.ln()
    pdf.ln(4)

output_path = "./testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf"
pdf.output(output_path)
file_size = os.path.getsize(output_path)
print(f"PDF created: {output_path} ({file_size} bytes)")

# Also print paragraph count for verification
print(f"Converted {len(doc.paragraphs)} paragraphs and {len(doc.tables)} tables from DOCX")
'''

email_script = '''import email
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email import encoders
import os
from datetime import datetime

# Create the email message
msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = "assistant@example.com"
msg["To"] = "bob@example.com"
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Activity Report"
msg["Date"] = datetime.now().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S +0000")

# Email body
body = """Hi Bob,

Please find attached the customer activity report (PDF) converted from the original DOCX document. This report includes customer activity details for Maya Chen, including order ORD-6C71B1 from 2026-09-02 with a total of $79.

Best regards"""

msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

# Attach the PDF
pdf_path = "./testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf"
with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
    pdf_data = f.read()

attachment = MIMEBase("application", "pdf")
attachment.set_payload(pdf_data)
encoders.encode_base64(attachment)
attachment.add_header(
    "Content-Disposition",
    "attachment",
    filename="customer_report.pdf"
)
msg.attach(attachment)

# Save as .eml file in Bob's email directory
eml_path = "./testbed/emails/bob/Customer Activity Report.eml"
with open(eml_path, "w") as f:
    f.write(msg.as_string())

file_size = os.path.getsize(eml_path)
print(f"Email saved: {eml_path} ({file_size} bytes)")
print(f"To: bob@example.com")
print(f"Subject: Customer Activity Report")
print(f"Attachment: customer_report.pdf ({len(pdf_data)} bytes)")
